'''Kirma Umber''' was the wife of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Vlaçan Umber]]. She began to feel that her husband may have had an affair with [[Dejah Duare]], the partner of [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] artist [[Ves Volette]]. She went to see Volette alone to demand that he leave Dejah immediately, but he refused and Kirma left in a fury.<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">coruscant [[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows|nights]]</ref>

Kirma was one of the principal suspects in the murder Ves Volette, but was later exonerated after [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] revealed that the killer was the Baroness' own [[Umber 3PO unit|protocol droid]], who only wished to ease the suffering of its mistress.

Kirma was physically larger than her husband, Pavan surmised that it was a result of sexual dimorphism.
